mediaWork.title: Bone Valley
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Investigative journalism examining the wrongful conviction of Leo Schofield for the 1987 murder of his wife Michelle in Polk County, Florida.
mediaWork.summaryNotes: Hosted by Pulitzer Prize-winning author Gilbert King and produced by Lava for Good. Investigates Leo Schofield's 1989 murder conviction in Lakeland, Florida, uncovering fingerprint evidence and repeated confessions from another man, Jeremy Scott. Following the series, Schofield was granted parole and released in April 2024 after 36 years in prison while continuing to seek full exoneration.
